working_definition: Neurons of the sacculus or arista of the antenna, annotated coarsely as neuron without receptor detail (Li et al. 2022 FCA, Manual Annotation).
searches_performed: antennal olfactory receptor neuron of grooved sensillum of sacculus

best_match.fbbt_definition: Adult sensory neuron that receives sensory input in the antenna.

justification: Grouped location call (sacculus or arista). OLS ancestors verified: sacculus grooved-sensillum ORNs (Ir64a FBbt:00110019), hygrosensory Ir40a (FBbt:00110990) and aristal sensory neurons (FBbt:00007575) all descend from adult antennal sensory neuron. No sacculus/arista-specific neuron class exists.
